description:
## Status

The ownership bug was real, but this implementation is transitional and will not land from invalid PR #123.

RootSlot's grow-only history of every former entry ActivationKey exists only to stop SeedActivation from reconstructing input evidence from a quotient key. The final model in fz-kdt.200 deletes that reconstruction: SeedRoot and actual caller/latent evidence owners publish exact ActivationInputs rows, and removing an owner withdraws its normal claim.

Preserve the root rekeying, temporary keying withdrawal, self-recursive copublisher and no-resurrection regressions in fz-kdt.200. Delete SeedActivation key-to-row reconstruction, the historical RootSlot key set and routing side effects together. Do not cherry-pick faeb9d669 as architecture.
title: Superseded: delete activation-key evidence reconstruction
